test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 13 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the option that will improve the bracketed part of the sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select ‘No improvement required’.**

(Neither of the leading political parties have had much) success in the southern region.

options.text: Neither of the leading political parties has had much
Neither of the leading political party has had much
Neither of the leading political parties have had any

solution:
Here, the correct answer is **"****Neither of the leading political parties has had much."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The error lies in the part **"have had**" of the sentence. 
 
• **​"Neither of, either of, none of"** etc. are followed by **plural noun** and **singular verb**.
 
• **Examples:**
 
 
• Neither of these two boys** is** wrong.
 
• Either of you **was **present in the class.
 
 
 
• So, we must use the **singular helping verb "has" **in this case. 
 
• Hence, in the given sentence **'have had'** will be replaced by **'has had.'**
 
• ​So, the correct answer is **Option 2.**

 

Correct sentence: *Neither of the leading political parties **has**__ had much success in the southern region.*
